name: Chatsworth Farmyard and Adventure Playground
description: Woodland adventure playground with two towers, rope bridges, four slides (one over 12 metres long), a zip wire, climbing frames, swings, a giant sand area and an Archimedes screw. The towers are designed for children aged 6 to 11. There are toilets, baby change and an accessible toilet at the playground.
